text: フジ　ろうじん　ガラガラの　れいを　なぐさめに　いってたんだね

structure.jp: ガラガラの　れいを　なぐさめに

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: なぐさめに　いってた
patterns.explanation: A verb with ます cut off plus に, before a verb of coming or going, says what you come or go to do. なぐさめに　いってた = 'had gone to console'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いってた is the short spoken form of いっていた. With 'go', ている means having gone and being there, so the past form says he was away there. いってた = 'had gone'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a verb shows the speaker has just understood the reason behind something. いってたんだね = 'so he had gone, I see'.
